thread:
meera: Quick design question — proposing a new 'staged-degrade' rollout option. When primary model errors or latency spikes, route a configurable % to a fallback (smaller model) OR optionally return a stale cached response for specific routes. How should console/ API expose this (toggles, headers, audit sampling)? cc @devon @kai

devon: I like the idea. A couple clarifying q's: what signals trigger the switch (5xx, p95 latency, token budget?), and do we want a built-in hysteresis window? Also need audit trace linking the event to samples.

kai: Proposed triggers: (1) error_rate > threshold over rolling 1m window, (2) p95 latency > threshold, (3) explicit manual operator override. Hysteresis: require condition hold for 2 consecutive windows. Expose `degrade_reason` and `degrade_trace_id` in response headers.

anika: Console UX: add per-route "Degrade policy" card with: slider for fallback percent, dropdown for fallback_type (model | stale_cache), checkbox "allow audit sampling" and sample rate input. Show real-time sparkline for trigger signals + last triggered timestamp. Keep settings per-route + override at service level.

rachel: Ops/Privacy note: we should store request+response samples for failed->degraded events but default to 0.5% sampling. Include privacy modes: `suppress_payload`, `hash_only`, and `full` (opt-in only). Must surface KMS/HSM retention rules.

devon: Example policy JSON to discuss:
```
{
  "name": "staged-degrade-v1",
  "triggers": {
    "error_rate": {"window_s": 60, "threshold_pct": 2.0},
    "p95_latency_ms": {"window_s": 60, "threshold_ms": 900}
  },
  "fallback_strategy": {
    "type": "model",            // or "stale_cache"
    "fallback_percent": 30,
    "model_version": "redwood-compact-1"
  },
  "audit": {"sample_rate_pct": 0.5, "store_samples": true},
  "hysteresis_windows": 2
}
```

meera: On API contract — should clients receive 200 with metadata header (so existing clients keep working) or a 503/502 when primary fails? Product leans toward 200 + metadata.

kai: Strongly prefer 200 by default. Many integrations choke on non-2xx. Plan: return normal status + header `X-Redwood-Degraded: true`, `X-Redwood-Fallback: model|cache`, and `X-Redwood-Degrade-Id: <id>` for correlation. For structured responses (tool-calling/JSON), include a top-level `redwood_meta.degrade` object when allowed.

anika: For the console's audit/replay flow: include a "replay" action on sampled events that replays the same request against a sandboxed model for triage. Replay should be RBAC gated and write-only to a secure audit log. Track operator that initiated manual overrides and show that in the timeline.

devon: Telemetry suggestion: new metric `rollout.degrade_events` with labels {route, reason, fallback_type, model_version}. Also emit an event `degrade_event` to internal bus with `degrade_event_id` which links to stored sample(s). That ID should be surfaceable in the UI and in the header.

rachel: Also: retention policy — samples kept for 30 days by default, with enterprise opt-ins for longer. Make sure to add automatic scrubbing for PII fields based on schema + a review workflow.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — canary for `staged-degrade` RFC scheduled tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will run against `staging` w/ fallback_percent=5% :rocket:

meera: SGTM. I'll update the RFC doc with the policy JSON, header contract, and sample retention/privacy knobs. I'll add a short mockup for the per-route card and a proposed replay RBAC matrix. Thanks all :handshake:
